title: Token Time Continuous Diffusion for Language Modeling
abstract: arXiv:2607.14106v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In this paper we introduce token time continuous diffusion (TTCD), a new diffusion language model which (a) operates in continuous space, deterministically mapping Gaussian noise to a final token canvas with no further sampling, and crucially (b) incorporates a new notion of per-token times, with some tokens proceeding from noise to token at a faster rate than others. Continuous space modeling helps TTCD avoid the parallel sampling of multiple tokens, which is a key source of inaccuracy at high speedups for models that iterate purely in discrete space. The notion of per-token times helps TTCD to better model conditional generation, allows for more sure tokens to proceed at a faster rate, and allows for differentiated inter-token influences during refinement. translated_title: 用于语言建模的词元时间连续扩散模型
translated_abstract: 本文介绍了词元时间连续扩散（TTCD），这是一种新的扩散语言模型，它（a）在连续空间中运行，确定性地将高斯噪声映射到最终的词元画布上，无需进一步的采样；且至关重要的是（b）引入了一种新的“逐词元时间”（per-token times）概念，使某些词元能够以比其他词元更快的速度从噪声转变为词元。连续空间建模帮助TTCD避免了对多个词元进行并行采样，而并行采样正是纯离散空间迭代模型在高加速比下产生不准确性的关键原因。逐词元时间的概念帮助TTCD更好地建模条件生成，允许更确定的词元以更快的速度推进，并允许在精炼过程中对词元之间的影响进行差异化处理。TTCD在高加速比下优于离散模型。我们在OpenWebText数据集上训练了一个1.6亿参数的TTCD模型，并随后对其进行了自蒸馏；我们发现在高加速比下我们具有可比的性能（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 本文提出词元时间连续扩散（TTCD），一种在连续空间中运行、确定性映射噪声到词元并引入逐词元时间概念的新型扩散语言模型，在高加速比下性能优于离散扩散模型。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Token Time Continuous Diffusion (TTCD), a novel diffusion language model that operates in continuous space, deterministically maps noise to tokens, and incorporates a new per-token times concept, outperforming discrete diffusion models at high speedups.
